# Button

Labeled command button in five style families — Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Destructive and Brand / Expressive — at three sizes.

`RA.Button` · 11a — Actions

## Use

```jsx
<RA.Button>…</RA.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="RA.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary" \| "destructive" \| "expressive"` |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |
| `leadingIcon` | `IconName` |  |
| `trailingIcon` | `IconName` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
